final: WITH dc AS (SELECT a.district_id AS district_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM disp d JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY a.district_id), tot AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS t FROM dc) SELECT di.A3 AS region, AVG(dc.cnt) AS avg_clients_per_district, AVG(CAST(dc.cnt AS REAL) / tot.t) AS avg_share FROM dc JOIN district di ON di.district_id = dc.district_id CROSS JOIN tot GROUP BY di.A3
